title: DemoExecutionAuthorization (v0.2, RESULT-002 successor)
$comment: DEMONSTRATION LANE ONLY. The single artifact that can open the result-bearing execution gate. It binds the exact implementation commit, the exact scenario input bytes, the exact kernel commit and the exact output directory, so an authorization cannot be re-aimed at a different tree, a different scenario, a different kernel or a different destination. Absent a conforming artifact whose bindings match observed state, `oic demo run` refuses with RESULT_BEARING_EXECUTION_NOT_AUTHORIZED. No flag, environment variable or default is an alternative route. This schema DESCRIBES a future artifact; no such artifact exists in this work order.

implementation_commit.description: The exact Git commit this authorization is issued against. A run from any other tree is not the run that was authorized.

scenario_bundle_digest.description: Deterministic identity over the exact scenario input bytes: sorted relative path plus SHA-256 per file, canonically serialized, then digested.

allowed_output_directory.description: The only destination this authorization permits an evidence package to be written to.

authorized_reliance_case_ids.description: Only case-1 reaches ALLOW, so only case-1 may receive reliance authorization. Evaluation establishes the property; issuance creates the reliance, and no evaluation result creates one by itself.

semantic_oracle_path.description: Repository-relative path of the frozen semantic oracle.

semantic_oracle_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the exact oracle bytes, recomputed before the kernel is invoked.

description: Successor to v0.1. Identical in every binding it already carried, and adds three: the result identity, the path of the semantic oracle, and the exact SHA-256 of the oracle bytes. RESULT-002 makes the oracle a separately bound experimental object, so implementation_commit alone is deliberately not sufficient to establish it.
